$description: DHCW Single Record Design System — Elevation tokens. Two functional tokens, each with exactly one named job; there is deliberately no generic numeric scale. Shadow colour derives from navy-900 (#1B294A) rather than pure black, so shadows read as tinted rather than grey on the clinical displays this system targets. Sync source: Figma Elevation & Shadow page (110:2) and the Figma Elevation/* effect styles. Reference: foundations/tokens/elevation.md.

elevation.$description: Functional elevation tokens. Emitted as ready-to-use CSS box-shadow values, so a component never composes a shadow by hand. A button press-affordance step was specified until 2026-07-29 and dropped: it was never implemented in code or in the Figma component, and the design lead confirmed it is not wanted.

raised.$description: Cards and panels: a gentle lift from the page surface. Use only where a border alone is insufficient to separate a surface from its background, for example a white card on a near-white page. Also used by the patient banner and the navigation sidebar.

overlay.$description: All floating layers: modals, side drawers, dropdown menus and tooltips. The deeper shadow communicates that the surface sits above the page rather than on it. Never use the raised step for a floating layer — a card-weight shadow reads flat against a modal's own backdrop.
